data.title: 夏洛特 · 晨光教室的爱心便当
data.description: 晨光清朗的教室内，夏洛特双手捧着精心包裹在碎花方巾里的爱心便当递到你面前。她金发侧马尾垂在胸前，澄澈橙眸泛着羞涩水光，满含期待与宠溺。
data.action: holding out wrapped bento box with both hands, blushing sweetly, shy affectionate smile, morning sunlight
data.lighting: warm cheerful morning sunlight slanting through classroom glass
data.mood: tender school romance, domestic sweetness, pure puppy love
data.promptProse: Standing in a sunlit classroom, Charlotte Dunois hands over a wrapped bento box with both hands, blushing sweetly with loving eyes.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte handing over a lovingly made bento box in a morning classroom.
